title: COMPILER CONSTRUCTION I PRINCIPLES AND TECHNIQUES OF COMPILER
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to store their names and their associated information."
Arrays are used to store their names and their associated information.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a description of the form that the lexemes making up a token in a source program may have."
A pattern is a description of the form that the lexemes making up a token in a source program may have.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the set of strings accepted by the NFA."
The language defined by an NFA is the set of strings accepted by the NFA.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to transform an input to produce outputs and behaviour."
Substitution rules are used to transform an input to produce outputs and behaviour.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with improving in some way the generated object code while ensuring the result is identical."
Optimisation within a compiler is concerned with improving in some way the generated object code while ensuring the result is identical.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a size optimisation (although it also produces some speed improvement) that aims to remove logically impossible statements from the generated object code."
Dead code elimination is a size optimisation (although it also produces some speed improvement) that aims to remove logically impossible statements from the generated object code.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to investigate closure properties of classes of languages."
String homomorphism Such string operations are used to investigate closure properties of classes of languages.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the theoretical basis for the syntax of most programming languages."
Context-free languages are the theoretical basis for the syntax of most programming languages.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the same for all LR parsers, only the parsing table changes from one parser to another."
The driver routine is the same for all LR parsers, only the parsing table changes from one parser to another.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an input that states the characteristics of the lexical analyser for the language."
LEX source is an input that states the characteristics of the lexical analyser for the language.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a simple shift-reduce parser capable of parsing a subset of LR(1) grammars."
An operator-precedence parser is a simple shift-reduce parser capable of parsing a subset of LR(1) grammars.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the symbols or identifiers while values are the attributes obtained from declaration and usage on the symbols."
Arguments are the symbols or identifiers while values are the attributes obtained from declaration and usage on the symbols.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to derive one expression from one or more other expressions."
A formal system is used to derive one expression from one or more other expressions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the next to be executed; 5) Conditional jumps such as: if x relop y goto L."
The three-address statement with label L is the next to be executed; 5) Conditional jumps such as: if x relop y goto L.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the property that there need be no limit on the number of entries that can be in the table."
Open hashing refers to the property that there need be no limit on the number of entries that can be in the table.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the so called three-address code."
A popular intermediate language is the so called three-address code.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a linearised representation of a syntax tree; it is a list of the nodes of the in which a node appears immediately after its children."
Postfix notation is a linearised representation of a syntax tree; it is a list of the nodes of the in which a node appears immediately after its children.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a strategy for doing top-down parsing."
Recursive descent is a strategy for doing top-down parsing.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a linearised representation of a syntax tree or a dag in which explicit names correspond to the interior nodes of the graph."
Three-address code is a linearised representation of a syntax tree or a dag in which explicit names correspond to the interior nodes of the graph.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an implementation of a predictive parser that keeps the symbols on a stack explicitly, without maintaining them implicitly via recursive calls."
A nonrecursive parser is an implementation of a predictive parser that keeps the symbols on a stack explicitly, without maintaining them implicitly via recursive calls.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the smallest unit recognisable by the compiler."
A token is the smallest unit recognisable by the compiler.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a special-purpose programming language for creating programmes to process streams of input characters."
Lex is a special-purpose programming language for creating programmes to process streams of input characters.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to quadruple numbers in a quadruple array."
Suppose that labels refer to quadruple numbers in a quadruple array.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a set of rules for rewriting strings, along with a "start symbol" from which rewriting must start."
A formal grammar is a set of rules for rewriting strings, along with a "start symbol" from which rewriting must start.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a programme that takes as input a string x and answers "yes" if x is a sentence of L and "no" otherwise."
A recogniser for a language L is a programme that takes as input a string x and answers "yes" if x is a sentence of L and "no" otherwise.
fib: ______ is used to move rarely executed code outside of the main function body.
Profiling information
Profiling information is used to move rarely executed code outside of the main function body.
______ is a graphical representation for derivation that filters out the choice regarding replacement.
Parse tree
Parse tree is a graphical representation for derivation that filters out the choice regarding replacement.
______ is the only grammar which can construct the parse tree even though the given grammar is ambiguous.
Operator precedence grammar
Operator precedence grammar is the only grammar which can construct the parse tree even though the given grammar is ambiguous.
______ is a notable example of this.
Java byte code
Java byte code is a notable example of this.
______ is used the flag is checked and an error is reported if it is 'undefined'.
Whenever a variable
Whenever a variable is used the flag is checked and an error is reported if it is 'undefined'.

______ is a programme that translates a source programme written in some high-level programming language (such as Java) into machine code for some computer architecture (such as the Intel Pentium architecture).
compiler

A compiler is a programme that translates a source programme written in some high-level programming language (such as Java) into machine code for some computer architecture (such as the Intel Pentium architecture).
______ is the simplest to implement, but its performance is poor when n and e are large.
linear list
A linear list is the simplest to implement, but its performance is poor when n and e are large.
______ is a grammar in which the left-hand side of each production rule consists of only a single non-terminal symbol.
context-free grammar
A context-free grammar is a grammar in which the left-hand side of each production rule consists of only a single non-terminal symbol.
______ is a logically cohesive operation that takes as input one representation of the source programme and produces as output another representation.
phase
A phase is a logically cohesive operation that takes as input one representation of the source programme and produces as output another representation.

______ means (AB)C and is equivalent to A(BC)), alternation is commutative (i.e., A| B = B| A), repetition is idempotent (i.e., A** = A*), and concatenation distributes over alternation (eg, (a| b)c = ac| bc).
ABC

ABC means (AB)C and is equivalent to A(BC)), alternation is commutative (i.e., A| B = B| A), repetition is idempotent (i.e., A** = A*), and concatenation distributes over alternation (eg, (a| b)c = ac| bc).
______ is called local if it is performed by looking at statements within one concrete block.
code improving transformation
A code improving transformation is called local if it is performed by looking at statements within one concrete block.
______ are a very convenient form of representing (possibly infinite) sets of strings, called regular sets.
Regular expressions
Regular expressions are a very convenient form of representing (possibly infinite) sets of strings, called regular sets.
______ is a set of words, i.e. finite strings of letters, symbols, or tokens.
formal language
A formal language is a set of words, i.e. finite strings of letters, symbols, or tokens.
______ is called LEX source and the output of LEX compiler is called lexical analyser i.e. the LEX compiler generate lexical analyser.
input to the LEX compiler
The input to the LEX compiler is called LEX source and the output of LEX compiler is called lexical analyser i.e. the LEX compiler generate lexical analyser.
______ is a bottom-up parser that interprets an operator-precedence grammar.
operator precedence parser
An operator precedence parser is a bottom-up parser that interprets an operator-precedence grammar.
______ is the process of recognising an utterance by breaking it down to a set of symbols and analysing each one against the grammar of the language.
Parsing
Parsing is the process of recognising an utterance by breaking it down to a set of symbols and analysing each one against the grammar of the language.
______ is a function in computing that determines whether a given string belongs to the language or is grammatically incorrect.
Recogniser
Recogniser is a function in computing that determines whether a given string belongs to the language or is grammatically incorrect.
______ is a name, perhaps a temporary, that denotes an expression with an I-value such as A[i, j], and x is a pointer name or temporary.
Presumably y
Presumably y is a name, perhaps a temporary, that denotes an expression with an I-value such as A[i, j], and x is a pointer name or temporary.
______ is a compiler optimisation for improving code locality.
Function chunking
Function chunking is a compiler optimisation for improving code locality.
______ is a stack automaton which is in one of several discrete states.
parser
The parser is a stack automaton which is in one of several discrete states.
______ is a pair whose first component is the stack contents and whose second component is the unexpended input.
configuration of an LR parser
A configuration of an LR parser is a pair whose first component is the stack contents and whose second component is the unexpended input.
______ is the speed with which an entry can be added or accessed.
issue
An issue is the speed with which an entry can be added or accessed.
______ are known to be closed under union, concatenation, and intersection with regular languages, but not closed under intersection or complement.
free languages
free languages are known to be closed under union, concatenation, and intersection with regular languages, but not closed under intersection or complement.

LL (K) grammars
LL grammars
